I even told you that back in August right here, when ADA was at like one dollar... In my opinion, it made sense to be bullish right there, because the price got above the buy-market-support band, and also because we had a crossing by buy-market- buying support band as well, but also because on the Bitcoin chart we were above the previous all-time highs which historically gave us a huge drop on the Bitcoin dominance chart but obviously that did not end up happening. the exact same pattern as we had in the previous bear market, and also that comment that said that I was bullish back in August seems to forget that back then, if you just go back and watch, you know, my videos videos i always said that you know buying it like let's say one dollar is definitely not the best idea because if the price decides to go down you're probably going to lose a lot of money But honestly there's not much to adjust here, I mean this was a very clear 1-2-3-4-5 setup, so the worst thing to happen right now would be for the maybe third wave to not be and maybe this was just some kind of one two three four five setup for that third wave so maybe this was some kind of one two three and right now we're gonna get the fourth and then we get the fifth of the third wave you get the idea this could go a bunch of different ways but yeah it's probably gonna continue to go lower until bitcoin bottoms and until cardano bottoms as well before i end this this video, I also promised you that I'm going to give you a bear market strategy. So I'm going to wait for Bitcoin to drop to maybe $40,000 or even $35,000. I'm going to be buying Bitcoin and then for the next couple of years, I'm going to be continuing to buying Bitcoin on the way up until we get to new all-time highs. That's pretty much it, I hope you enjoyed, if you did make sure to checkout our youtube memberships & our patreon if you want access to all of our shirts & you want access to our daily discord updates.
